glosses: To feel very sad about; to mourn; to sorrow for.
To submit or file a grievance (about).

examples.text: Even if the executive director rules against the employee on appeal, the employee can still grieve the termination to the superintendent followed by an appeal to the … Board of Trustees.

glosses: A governor of a town or province.
A manager or steward, e.g. of a farm.
